title: Premature disruptive validation
summary: Showing errors while a user is still entering a valid answer can create noise, anxiety, and false failures.
problem: Per-keystroke or immediate blur validation often reports incomplete values before users have finished.
use_when: Auditing forms that display blocking errors before submission or before enough information exists to validate meaningfully
avoid_when: Immediate feedback is genuinely helpful, non-disruptive, and can be correct before completion
rationale: Validation timing is part of interaction design.
Preventing errors is better than repeatedly declaring temporary input invalid.

signals: blur immediately creates a blocking error for unfinished input
